properties.title: Domino Square opened on the Williamsburg waterfront
properties.short_description: Domino Park public materials recorded the opening of Domino Square on 24 September 2024 as a one-acre public plaza and events space extending Domino Park.
properties.explanation: A new public plaza and events space entered use within the Domino Sugar redevelopment area.

properties.title: Downtown Art Community Center renovation completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and DCLA announced on 19 March 2024 the completion of a city-funded renovation of the Downtown Art Community Center in Manhattan.
properties.explanation: The East 4th Street cultural center reached documented completion of new studio, kitchen, office, bathroom, storage, lighting, HVAC, and finish upgrades.

properties.title: Downtown Art reopened after city-funded renovation
properties.short_description: NYC DCLA and DDC announced completion of a city-funded renovation of Downtown Art Community Center in the East Village.
properties.explanation: A renovated cultural and performing-arts space reopened on East 4th Street.

properties.title: East 94th Street zoning text was adopted
properties.short_description: The NYC Zoning Resolution records East 94th Street, N 230242 ZRM, with an adopted date of March 19, 2024.
properties.explanation: A documented zoning text milestone was recorded for the East 94th Street project area in Manhattan.

properties.title: East River Park ballfields and Delancey Street Bridge opened
properties.short_description: The NYC Mayor's Office recorded the opening of new East River Park Ballfields 1 and 2 and the ADA-accessible Delancey Street Bridge on 10 September 2024.
properties.explanation: The first park areas in the East Side Coastal Resiliency project re-entered public use with new fields and an access bridge over FDR Drive.

properties.title: First East Side Coastal Resiliency section was completed
properties.short_description: NYC announced completion of the first section of East Side Coastal Resiliency in Manhattan, covering the area north of East 15th Street to Asser Levy Playground with raised parkland, floodwalls, berms, and flood gates.
properties.explanation: A coastal resiliency project section with parkland, floodwall, berm, and flood-gate works was recorded as completed on Manhattan's East Side.

properties.title: East Village homeownership program completion was celebrated
properties.short_description: NYC HPD recorded a March 4, 2024 ribbon-cutting for completion of a homeownership program rehabilitating century-old tenements at 406-08 East 10th Street, 533 East 11th Street, and 656 East 12th Street.
properties.explanation: Three city-owned multifamily buildings were documented as rehabilitated for affordable cooperative homeownership and additional affordable apartments.

properties.title: Special Eastchester-East Tremont Corridor District was adopted
properties.short_description: The NYC Zoning Resolution records the Special Eastchester-East Tremont Corridor District, N 240016 ZRX, with a City Council adoption date of August 15, 2024 and Article XIV Chapter 5 district rules.
properties.explanation: A documented special-purpose zoning district change was recorded for the Eastchester-East Tremont corridor in the Bronx.

properties.title: Etihad Park broke ground at Willets Point
properties.short_description: The NYC Mayor's Office announced that city officials and New York City Football Club broke ground on Etihad Park, a new soccer stadium at Willets Point, on December 4, 2024.
properties.explanation: A documented mayoral announcement recorded the groundbreaking for a new stadium project at Willets Point.

properties.title: Far Rockaway Library opened its new building
properties.short_description: NYC Department of Design and Construction recorded the opening of the new Far Rockaway Library on 30 July 2024.
properties.explanation: A new public library building entered use in downtown Far Rockaway.

properties.title: Flatbush Avenue plaza and Park Slope infrastructure project completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC announced completion of a Park Slope infrastructure project that replaced water mains, upgraded combined sewers, and renovated the 8th Avenue Triangle / Flatbush Avenue public space.
properties.explanation: Water, sewer, sidewalk, ramp, and plaza upgrades were recorded as completed near Flatbush Avenue and Grand Army Plaza.

properties.title: Forest Hills and Rego Park water-main upgrades were completed
properties.short_description: NYC DEP and DDC announced completion of a USD 9 million project that upgraded nearly four miles of older water mains in Forest Hills and Rego Park.
properties.explanation: A water-distribution infrastructure project replacing older mains with ductile iron pipes was recorded as completed in Forest Hills and Rego Park.

properties.title: Frederick Douglass Memorial Park was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: The NYC Mayor's Office and Landmarks Preservation Commission announced designation of Staten Island's Frederick Douglass Memorial Park as an individual landmark on June 18, 2024.
properties.explanation: A documented city announcement changed the listed preservation status of Frederick Douglass Memorial Park to individual landmark.

properties.title: Heckscher Building was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission announced designation of the Heckscher Building, now the Crown Building, at 730 Fifth Avenue as an individual landmark on May 14, 2024.
properties.explanation: A documented LPC vote changed the listed preservation status of the Heckscher Building to individual landmark.

properties.title: HELP ONE Buildings A and B opened in East New York
properties.short_description: NYC HDC recorded the March 14, 2024 completion and opening of HELP ONE Buildings A and B in East New York.
properties.explanation: Two affordable and supportive housing buildings were documented as open with 255 low-income and supportive homes.

properties.title: Hillcrest Library reopened after roof and HVAC renovation
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and Queens Public Library recorded Hillcrest Library reopening on 24 September 2024 after a roof, HVAC, and climate-control renovation.
properties.explanation: The Hillcrest Library branch returned to documented public use after replacement of the roof and major building-systems work.

properties.title: Hillside Grove development team was selected
properties.short_description: NYC HPD announced on December 30, 2024 that a development team had been selected to transform the 539 Jersey Street sanitation garage site into Hillside Grove.
properties.explanation: A documented HPD announcement selected a development team for a mixed-use affordable housing, grocery, community-space, and open-space proposal on Staten Island.

properties.title: Hostos Community College opened its Advisement Center facilities
properties.short_description: CUNY Facilities Planning, Construction and Management recorded that Hostos Community College unveiled the Advisement Center facilities at 429 Grand Concourse on February 29, 2024, followed by a ribbon-cutting ceremony.
properties.explanation: A documented opening or public-use milestone was recorded for the named facility.
